outcome_detail: $2,999,999 settlement paid by the City of Claremont's insurance provider, approved/announced in late June 2025, in exchange for release of claims against the city, the former officer, and unnamed defendants; the city stated the settlement was not an admission of wrongdoing.
criminal_detail: Gabriel Arellanes was arrested March 14, 2025 by San Bernardino County sheriff's investigators on one count of felony forcible oral copulation (maximum eight years in state prison plus lifetime sex-offender registration if convicted). He pleaded not guilty at an April 30, 2025 arraignment at Rancho Cucamonga Superior Court. No resolution of the criminal case found in available reporting as of July 2026.
description: A Highland, California woman filed a federal civil rights lawsuit on October 4, 2024 in the Central District of California against former Claremont police officer Gabriel Arellanes, the City of Claremont, and city employees. According to the complaint, Arellanes arrested her for drug possession on February 16, 2024, sexually assaulted her during transport toward the Pomona police station, and forced her to perform oral sex on him in a Montclair transit center parking lot. The suit alleged unlawful seizure, unreasonable force, sexual battery under California Civil Code Section 1708.5, and violations of the Tom Bane Civil Rights Act, with reported damage demands of up to $20-25 million. In June 2025, the city's insurer agreed to pay the plaintiff $2,999,999 to settle; the city said the settlement was not an admission of wrongdoing. Arellanes, who had been hired in 2022, resigned in January 2025 after months on administrative leave, and pleaded not guilty to a felony forcible oral copulation charge in April 2025.

confidence_notes: Settlement date 2025-06-27 is the date of press coverage of the approved settlement, not necessarily the formal execution date. Reported damage demand varies across coverage ($20M in Courier arrest article headline, up to $25M in later Courier reporting). One aggregator summary placed the arrest in March 2024, but Claremont Courier reporting (arrest March 14, arraignment April 30, following the October 2024 civil filing and January 2025 resignation) places the arrest in March 2025. Outcome of the criminal case beyond the not-guilty plea was not found in dedicated searches as of 2026-07-28.
